# anything), from the INCLUSION criteria and title only.

# Matching: whole words, case-insensitive, hyphen/space interchangeable, an
# optional plural "s"; the longest matching term wins where terms overlap.
# A term in ALL CAPS is matched case-sensitively (abbreviations).
# Format as before: every active row is term / targets or (same as "term") /
# unless-preceded-by regex / why, one token per cell, no "/" in a term, and
# (same as ...) rows carry no regex. Rows that would need more than that are
# sarcomas: IMT kept (paediatric NRSTS studies enrol it without naming it);
#   GIST and desmoid out; NRSTS = STS minus RMS and Ewing of soft tissue; the
#   STS, NRSTS and soft-tissue-or-bone lists rebuilt from two base sets - the
#   old NRSTS and soft-tissue-or-bone rows had lost glomangiosarcoma,
#   malignant glomus tumour and dendritic cell sarcoma; more qualifiers for
# gliomas: DMG explicit in the HGG and GBM rows; oligodendroglioma also maps
#   to pediatric-type diffuse LGG, with an anaplastic row to stop that;
#   pHGG/pLGG, glioneuronal tumour, optic pathway glioma.
# leukaemias: lineage guard on ALL extended (Ph+, Ph-like, B/T-lineage, BCP,
#   ETP, CD19/CD20/CD22 for B, CD1a/CD3/CD7 for T); "acute leukemia" guarded against MPAL wording and given a longer
#   ALAL row; lymphoblastic lymphoma/LBL; leukemia-or-lymphoma basket.
# new sections: lymphomas (CHECK node names), neuroblastoma, paediatric
#   basket wordings; British and -ical spellings that fell through; the
#   basket rows carry the pre-text half of the enumeration guard ("selected",
#   "the following" ...), which works as a lookbehind today.
# abbreviation rows now use (same as "...") so they cannot drift from the
#   full-name row - except ALL, LBL and the two British leukaemia rows, which
#   keep explicit targets because they carry a regex. Rows that need loader
#   work sit at the end, commented out.

# --- 2026-10-02, the CHECKs against the pinned release (ref/oncotree_file.txt) ---

# "sarcoma of bone", "sarcomas of bone": explicit targets plus an Ewing/Kaposi
#   guard, so "Ewing sarcoma of bone or soft tissue" no longer floors the
# In the loader, not the table: Unicode hyphens folded to "-" before

#   sclerosing, pleomorphic, fusion status), so a named subtype stays itself.
#    as a space (DIPG/DMG, ALL/LBL, relapsed/refractory), optional "s" on

# 2. DONE 2026-10-02. guard syntax: a guard containing "§" is matched against
